item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena shines a torch onto a plane mirror fixed on the wall of her classroom. She holds a white sheet of card so that the incident ray and the normal to the mirror both lie along the sheet. What must be true for the reflected ray to appear on the same sheet?

options.A: The reflected ray always lies in the same plane as the incident ray and the normal, so it will appear on the sheet
options.B: The reflected ray lies in a different plane from the incident ray, so it cannot appear on the sheet
options.C: The reflected ray lies in the same plane as the incident ray but not the normal, so it may not appear on the sheet
options.D: The reflected ray can lie in any plane, so bending the sheet makes no difference to where it appears
